units.id: mission:Avgi: Dissonance Outreach|name|873|0
units.english: Dissonance Outreach
units.italian: Apertura alla Dissonanza

units.id: mission:Avgi: Dissonance Outreach|description|874|0
units.english: Take Hriso to <destination> for negotiations with the local miners. You may need to hail the station to receive permission to dock.
units.italian: Porta Hriso su <destination> per negoziare con i minatori del posto. Potrebbe servirti contattare la stazione per ottenere il permesso di attracco.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Dissonance Outreach|blocked|878|0
units.english: You'll need <capacity> to transport Darius, Sora, and Hriso.
units.italian: Ti serve <capacity> per trasportare Darius, Sora e Hriso.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Dissonance Outreach|log|885|0
units.english: Hriso is an Avgi diplomat, who negotiates with dissenters unhappy with Consonance rule. While loyal to the Consonance, he seems to have some sympathy for the Dissonance movement and its views.
units.italian: Hriso è un diplomatico Avgi che negozia con i dissidenti scontenti del dominio della Consonanza. Leale alla Consonanza, sembra però provare una certa simpatia per il movimento della Dissonanza e per le sue posizioni.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Dissonance Outreach|log|886|0
units.english: Sora takes a negative view on the Dissonance, and those who she sees as not contributing to the war effort against the Aberrant.
units.italian: Sora ha una visione negativa della Dissonanza e di chi, secondo lei, non contribuisce allo sforzo bellico contro gli Aberranti.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Dissonance Outreach|log|887|0
units.english: Membership in the Consonance varies widely between the various Avgi polities, and a significant portion of the Avgi that escaped the Aberrant do not recognize its legitimacy.
units.italian: L'adesione alla Consonanza varia molto tra le diverse entità politiche Avgi, e una parte significativa degli Avgi sfuggiti agli Aberranti non ne riconosce la legittimità.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Dissonance Outreach|log|888|0
units.english: The Dissonance is a catchall term for the various groups and individuals who do not accept the Consonance as a unified Avgi government. Ranging from anarchists to dissenting corporations, the Dissonance is a big-tent movement rather than being a centralized group.
units.italian: La Dissonanza è un termine ombrello per i vari gruppi e individui che non accettano la Consonanza come governo unitario degli Avgi. Dagli anarchici alle corporazioni dissidenti, la Dissonanza è un movimento ampio e variegato, non un gruppo centralizzato.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Dissonance Outreach|Hriso turns out to be a yellow-orange Avgi of middling age. "Excitement. A true pleasure to meet you, Captain <first> <last>. I look forward to your company during these negotiations."|890|0
units.english: Hriso turns out to be a yellow-orange Avgi of middling age. "Excitement. A true pleasure to meet you, Captain <first> <last>. I look forward to your company during these negotiations."
units.italian: Hriso si rivela un Avgi giallo-arancio di mezza età. "Entusiasmo. Un vero piacere conoscerla, capitano <first> <last>. Non vedo l'ora di averla con me durante queste trattative."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Dissonance Outreach|	"Aren't the Avgi united under the Consonance?"|892|0
units.english: "Aren't the Avgi united under the Consonance?"
units.italian: "Gli Avgi non sono uniti sotto la Consonanza?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Dissonance Outreach|	"Who are you negotiating with exactly?"|893|0
units.english: "Who are you negotiating with exactly?"
units.italian: "Con chi state negoziando, esattamente?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Dissonance Outreach|	He thrums in laughter. "One can only wish our species was that unified. No, membership in the Consonance is purely at-will, and many polities have chosen to go it alone even with the current crisis. Regret. The initial evacuation into the Tangled Shroud was haphazard to say the least, as much of it was, and still is, unmapped. Many captains took their ships down differing paths, meeting up with each other and forming alliances just to survive. In a way, it's a miracle that the Consonance was even able to reconstitute itself at all."|895|0
units.english: He thrums in laughter. "One can only wish our species was that unified. No, membership in the Consonance is purely at-will, and many polities have chosen to go it alone even with the current crisis. Regret. The initial evacuation into the Tangled Shroud was haphazard to say the least, as much of it was, and still is, unmapped. Many captains took their ships down differing paths, meeting up with each other and forming alliances just to survive. In a way, it's a miracle that the Consonance was even able to reconstitute itself at all."
units.italian: Vibra in una risata. "Si può solo sperare che la nostra specie sia così unita. No, l'adesione alla Consonanza è del tutto volontaria, e molte entità politiche hanno scelto di andare per conto proprio anche con la crisi in corso. Rincrescimento. L'evacuazione iniziale nel Tangled Shroud è stata quanto meno disordinata, visto che gran parte di quella regione era, ed è ancora, senza mappe. Molti capitani hanno portato le loro navi su rotte diverse, incontrandosi e formando alleanze solo per sopravvivere. In un certo senso è un miracolo che la Consonanza sia riuscita a ricostituirsi."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Dissonance Outreach|	"Those polities not fully aligned with the Consonance are largely independent of each other, but their movement has collectively been labeled as the 'Dissonance.' Imperative. Please do understand, we are not enemies, nor would I say we bear them any ill-will. The Dissonance participates in trade with us and de-facto follows the regulations passed by the Assembly, and each and every one of them wants the Aberrant scoured from our space as much as the rest of us."|898|0
units.english: "Those polities not fully aligned with the Consonance are largely independent of each other, but their movement has collectively been labeled as the 'Dissonance.' Imperative. Please do understand, we are not enemies, nor would I say we bear them any ill-will. The Dissonance participates in trade with us and de-facto follows the regulations passed by the Assembly, and each and every one of them wants the Aberrant scoured from our space as much as the rest of us."
units.italian: "Le entità politiche non del tutto allineate alla Consonanza sono in gran parte indipendenti tra loro, ma il loro movimento è stato etichettato collettivamente come 'Dissonanza'. Imperativo. Capisca bene, non siamo nemici, né direi che proviamo rancore. La Dissonanza commercia con noi e di fatto rispetta i regolamenti approvati dall'Assemblea, e ognuno di loro vuole spazzare via gli Aberranti dal nostro spazio quanto tutti gli altri."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Dissonance Outreach|	He looks directly at you. "The individuals we will be negotiating with on this trip are still loyal to the Consonance, merely unhappy with the price controls in place on certain minerals. Necessary for the Twilight Guard to expand the fleet," he explains.|899|0
units.english: He looks directly at you. "The individuals we will be negotiating with on this trip are still loyal to the Consonance, merely unhappy with the price controls in place on certain minerals. Necessary for the Twilight Guard to expand the fleet," he explains.
units.italian: Ti guarda dritto. "Le persone con cui negozieremo in questo viaggio sono ancora leali alla Consonanza, semplicemente scontente dei controlli sui prezzi di certi minerali. Necessari perché la Twilight Guard possa ampliare la flotta", spiega.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Dissonance Outreach|	Sora says, "I still think they're a bunch of cowards. The existence of your species is threatened, and you let someone else do the fighting? Then you complain about the price they can pay for iron? What kind of person does that?"|900|0
units.english: Sora says, "I still think they're a bunch of cowards. The existence of your species is threatened, and you let someone else do the fighting? Then you complain about the price they can pay for iron? What kind of person does that?"
units.italian: Sora dice: "Continuo a pensare che siano un branco di codardi. La vostra specie è minacciata e lasciate che siano altri a combattere? E poi vi lamentate del prezzo che possono pagare per il ferro? Che razza di persona lo fa?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Dissonance Outreach|	Hriso flicks his wings. "Reproach. The kind that still has to support themselves, and pay for the precision machinery they cannot make themselves. But we can discuss this later. For now, let us set off as soon as possible."|901|0
units.english: Hriso flicks his wings. "Reproach. The kind that still has to support themselves, and pay for the precision machinery they cannot make themselves. But we can discuss this later. For now, let us set off as soon as possible."
units.italian: Hriso agita le ali. "Rimprovero. Il tipo che deve comunque mantenersi e pagare i macchinari di precisione che non può produrre da sé. Ma ne parleremo dopo. Per ora, partiamo il prima possibile."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Dissonance Outreach|log|905|0
units.english: Agreed to transport Hriso to a Dissonance mining station in the Tangled Shroud, while Darius and Sora investigate a lead that could potentially help me escape the Twilight.
units.italian: Ho accettato di trasportare Hriso a una stazione mineraria della Dissonanza nel Tangled Shroud, mentre Darius e Sora seguono una pista che potrebbe aiutarmi a fuggire dal Twilight.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|name|910|0
units.english: Escape the Twilight
units.italian: Fuga dal Twilight

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|description|911|0
units.english: Find a way out of the Twilight. You may want to look to the far east of the Twilight, where the Incursion first began.
units.italian: Trova una via d'uscita dal Twilight. Conviene guardare all'estremo est, dove è cominciata l'Incursione.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|blocked|915|0
units.english: You'll need <capacity> on the <ship> to transport Darius, Sora, and Leon.
units.italian: Ti serve <capacity> sulla <ship> per trasportare Darius, Sora e Leon.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|log|919|0
units.english: Heard of a potential way out of the Twilight. Apparently, the Aberrant invaded through a chain of systems stretching to the East, and while no Avgi ships have been able to explore the area since the Incursion, Leon thinks there could be a way back to human space from there.
units.italian: Ho sentito parlare di una possibile via d'uscita dal Twilight. A quanto pare gli Aberranti hanno invaso passando per una catena di sistemi che si estende a est, e benché nessuna nave Avgi sia riuscita a esplorare la zona dopo l'Incursione, Leon pensa che da lì possa esserci una via di ritorno allo spazio umano.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|log|920|0
units.english: Independent miners, collectives, and corporations alike are unhappy with the price controls the Consonance has placed on minerals mined from asteroids. While the Consonance claims they are necessary due to the austere war economy and the need for raw materials, the artificially low prices make it hard to survive and make a living.
units.italian: Minatori indipendenti, collettivi e corporazioni sono ugualmente scontenti dei controlli che la Consonanza ha imposto sui prezzi dei minerali estratti dagli asteroidi. La Consonanza sostiene che siano necessari per l'austerità dell'economia di guerra e per il bisogno di materie prime, ma i prezzi artificialmente bassi rendono difficile sopravvivere e guadagnarsi da vivere.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|log|921|0
units.english: Leon was a scientist aboard Darius' ship when it became trapped in the Twilight. Unlike Sora, he definitely does blame Darius for having been trapped with the Avgi. While somewhat rude, he appears to have made several valuable connections and could be close to uncovering a way back to human space.
units.italian: Leon era uno scienziato a bordo della nave di Darius quando rimase intrappolata nel Twilight. A differenza di Sora, incolpa senz'altro Darius dell'essere rimasto bloccato con gli Avgi. Un po' sgarbato, sembra però aver fatto diverse conoscenze preziose ed essere vicino a scoprire una via di ritorno allo spazio umano.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|Outpost Tekis is a large station built into an asteroid several kilometers across, with networks of tubes and habitats crisscrossing the surface. You pull the <ship> into a cramped hangar dug into the rock and disembark with Hriso, who immediately sets out for a prearranged meeting place. You notice many of the Avgi in the outpost stare at you, Darius, and Sora, likely their first glimpse of a human.|923|0
units.english: Outpost Tekis is a large station built into an asteroid several kilometers across, with networks of tubes and habitats crisscrossing the surface. You pull the <ship> into a cramped hangar dug into the rock and disembark with Hriso, who immediately sets out for a prearranged meeting place. You notice many of the Avgi in the outpost stare at you, Darius, and Sora, likely their first glimpse of a human.
units.italian: L'Avamposto Tekis è una grande stazione costruita dentro un asteroide largo diversi chilometri, con una rete di tubi e habitat che si incrociano sulla superficie. Porti la <ship> in un hangar angusto scavato nella roccia e scendi con Hriso, che si dirige subito verso un luogo d'incontro prestabilito. Noti che molti Avgi dell'avamposto fissano te, Darius e Sora: probabilmente è la loro prima volta che vedono un umano.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	Together, you enter a large, round conference room with walls of polished rock. Waiting there are a handful of Avgi of various ages, who immediately begin conversing with Hriso in their own language.|924|0
units.english: Together, you enter a large, round conference room with walls of polished rock. Waiting there are a handful of Avgi of various ages, who immediately begin conversing with Hriso in their own language.
units.italian: Entrate insieme in una grande sala conferenze rotonda, con le pareti di roccia levigata. Lì aspettano una manciata di Avgi di età diverse, che cominciano subito a parlare con Hriso nella loro lingua.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	One of them looks at you and says, "Displeasure. So, do you expect a show of support by the aliens to move us? We were under the impression you were here to reconsider your positions, not calcify them."|925|0
units.english: One of them looks at you and says, "Displeasure. So, do you expect a show of support by the aliens to move us? We were under the impression you were here to reconsider your positions, not calcify them."
units.italian: Uno di loro ti guarda e dice: "Dispiacere. Quindi pensate che una dimostrazione di sostegno da parte degli alieni ci smuova? Avevamo capito che foste qui per riconsiderare le vostre posizioni, non per irrigidirle."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	"What are they talking about?"|927|0
units.english: "What are they talking about?"
units.italian: "Di cosa stanno parlando?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	(Remain silent.)|928|0
units.english: (Remain silent.)
units.italian: (Resta in silenzio.)

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	"Rebuke. Captain <last> is not here on 'my' side, or any other, merely as an observer curious of our ways." Hriso turns to you. "Consideration. I suppose you might be curious about what we are discussing. The local mining guild here says they cannot sustain their operations with the low price on iron mandated by the Consonance, as we are not buying enough rarer metals like titanium to make up for it."|930|0
units.english: "Rebuke. Captain <last> is not here on 'my' side, or any other, merely as an observer curious of our ways." Hriso turns to you. "Consideration. I suppose you might be curious about what we are discussing. The local mining guild here says they cannot sustain their operations with the low price on iron mandated by the Consonance, as we are not buying enough rarer metals like titanium to make up for it."
units.italian: "Rimprovero. Il capitano <last> non è qui dalla 'mia' parte, né da nessun'altra: è solo un osservatore curioso dei nostri modi." Hriso si volta verso di te. "Considerazione. Suppongo che si chieda di cosa stiamo parlando. La gilda mineraria locale dice che non può sostenere le proprie attività con il prezzo del ferro imposto dalla Consonanza, visto che non compriamo abbastanza metalli più rari come il titanio per compensare."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	"That's stupid," says Sora. "Without cheap steel we wouldn't be able to keep expanding Peripheria or build the Aktina Cylinder."|931|0
units.english: "That's stupid," says Sora. "Without cheap steel we wouldn't be able to keep expanding Peripheria or build the Aktina Cylinder."
units.italian: "È una stupidaggine", dice Sora. "Senza acciaio a buon mercato non potremmo continuare a espandere Peripheria né costruire il Cilindro Aktina."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	Hriso doesn't translate that, returning to conversing with the miners. Sora pulls out a translator of her own, listening intently to the conversation, but Darius pulls you aside. "I had a talk with a few people on the way here, and they say there's someone who knows more about the first days after the Incursion. Come on."|932|0
units.english: Hriso doesn't translate that, returning to conversing with the miners. Sora pulls out a translator of her own, listening intently to the conversation, but Darius pulls you aside. "I had a talk with a few people on the way here, and they say there's someone who knows more about the first days after the Incursion. Come on."
units.italian: Hriso non traduce, e torna a conversare con i minatori. Sora tira fuori un traduttore tutto suo e ascolta con attenzione la conversazione, ma Darius ti prende in disparte. "Ho parlato con un paio di persone mentre venivamo qui, e dicono che c'è qualcuno che sa di più sui primi giorni dopo l'Incursione. Andiamo."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	"What did they say?" you ask.|933|0
units.english: "What did they say?" you ask.
units.italian: "Cosa ti hanno detto?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	"Apparently it's someone we have to meet in person," he grumbles. "I don't like it, but I don't think it's anything dangerous. Just inconvenient." You excuse yourself and walk along with Darius.|934|0
units.english: "Apparently it's someone we have to meet in person," he grumbles. "I don't like it, but I don't think it's anything dangerous. Just inconvenient." You excuse yourself and walk along with Darius.
units.italian: "A quanto pare è uno che dobbiamo incontrare di persona", borbotta. "Non mi piace, ma non credo sia niente di pericoloso. Solo scomodo." Ti congedi e vai con Darius.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	Before long, you find yourself in some kind of mess hall, dozens of Avgi sipping from colorful drinks. Darius freezes as he spots a short man seated on a crude stool, the only human-style seating in the room, together with a few Avgi.|935|0
units.english: Before long, you find yourself in some kind of mess hall, dozens of Avgi sipping from colorful drinks. Darius freezes as he spots a short man seated on a crude stool, the only human-style seating in the room, together with a few Avgi.
units.italian: In breve vi ritrovate in una specie di mensa, con dozzine di Avgi che sorseggiano bevande colorate. Darius si blocca quando nota un uomo basso seduto su uno sgabello grezzo, l'unico posto a sedere in stile umano della sala, insieme a qualche Avgi.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	"Darius. I didn't expect to see you here," he says. "And, what's this, another human here in Avgi space?"|936|0
units.english: "Darius. I didn't expect to see you here," he says. "And, what's this, another human here in Avgi space?"
units.italian: "Darius. Non mi aspettavo di vederti qui", dice. "E cos'è questa storia, un altro umano nello spazio Avgi?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	Darius takes a while to respond. "Leon. It's been a while."|937|0
units.english: Darius takes a while to respond. "Leon. It's been a while."
units.italian: Darius ci mette un po' a rispondere. "Leon. Ne è passato di tempo."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	Leon snorts. "That's to say the least. Is Sora with you, or did you crawl here by yourself?"|938|0
units.english: Leon snorts. "That's to say the least. Is Sora with you, or did you crawl here by yourself?"
units.italian: Leon sbuffa. "A dir poco. Sora è con te, o sei strisciato fin qui da solo?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	"She's helping with some negotiations."|940|0
units.english: "She's helping with some negotiations."
units.italian: "Sta aiutando in delle trattative."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	(Let Darius do the talking.)|942|0
units.english: (Let Darius do the talking.)
units.italian: (Lascia parlare Darius.)

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	"She's with someone from the Consonance, negotiating with the miners here," says Darius.|944|0
units.english: "She's with someone from the Consonance, negotiating with the miners here," says Darius.
units.italian: "È con uno della Consonanza, a negoziare con i minatori qui", dice Darius.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	"And who's this?" Leon says, looking at you. "How'd you end up here, of all places?"|946|0
units.english: "And who's this?" Leon says, looking at you. "How'd you end up here, of all places?"
units.italian: "E chi è questo?" dice Leon guardandoti. "Come sei finito qui, proprio qui?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	"Captain <last>. I was stranded here, just like you."|948|0
units.english: "Captain <last>. I was stranded here, just like you."
units.italian: "Il capitano <last>. Sono rimasto bloccato qui, proprio come voi."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	"<first>. Pleased to meet you."|949|0
units.english: "<first>. Pleased to meet you."
units.italian: "<first>. Piacere di conoscerti."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	You quickly explain how you found yourself in Avgi space, and Leon nods. "That explains the questions the good Captain was asking," he says, nodding at Darius. "I've spent years collecting this information, from hearing the official narrative to dredging the corners of Avgi space for rumors."|951|0
units.english: You quickly explain how you found yourself in Avgi space, and Leon nods. "That explains the questions the good Captain was asking," he says, nodding at Darius. "I've spent years collecting this information, from hearing the official narrative to dredging the corners of Avgi space for rumors."
units.italian: Spieghi in fretta come sei finito nello spazio Avgi, e Leon annuisce. "Questo spiega le domande che faceva il buon capitano", dice, indicando Darius con un cenno. "Ho passato anni a raccogliere queste informazioni, dalla versione ufficiale ai pettegolezzi raccolti negli angoli più remoti dello spazio Avgi."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	He leans in. "So, before I tell you this, one condition. I've spent months looking for a way to get a ship to take me to... well, you'll see. But not a lot of captains are willing to take their ships out of the Tangled Shroud and through the Aberrant blockade, so if this leads anywhere, I want a bunk on your ship."|952|0
units.english: He leans in. "So, before I tell you this, one condition. I've spent months looking for a way to get a ship to take me to... well, you'll see. But not a lot of captains are willing to take their ships out of the Tangled Shroud and through the Aberrant blockade, so if this leads anywhere, I want a bunk on your ship."
units.italian: Si sporge in avanti. "Allora, prima di dirtelo, una condizione. Ho passato mesi a cercare una nave che mi portasse a... beh, vedrai. Ma non molti capitani sono disposti a portare le loro navi fuori dal Tangled Shroud e attraverso il blocco degli Aberranti, quindi se questo porta da qualche parte, voglio una cuccetta sulla tua nave."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	"Agreed."|954|0
units.english: "Agreed."
units.italian: "Affare fatto."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	"No deal."|956|0
units.english: "No deal."
units.italian: "Niente affare."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	You open your mouth to reply, but Darius beats you to the punch. "Of course, Leon."|957|0
units.english: You open your mouth to reply, but Darius beats you to the punch. "Of course, Leon."
units.italian: Apri la bocca per rispondere, ma Darius ti precede. "Certo, Leon."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	"Good. Well, it more or less comes down to this: the Incursion didn't come out of nowhere. Everyone says they came from beyond the furthest reaches of Avgi exploration, but that's not quite true. The first to encounter them was a scout ship, which went down within minutes against their weapons. But not before they sent out a single garbled transmission to their sister ship, which fled back to the rest of the Avgi."|960|0
units.english: "Good. Well, it more or less comes down to this: the Incursion didn't come out of nowhere. Everyone says they came from beyond the furthest reaches of Avgi exploration, but that's not quite true. The first to encounter them was a scout ship, which went down within minutes against their weapons. But not before they sent out a single garbled transmission to their sister ship, which fled back to the rest of the Avgi."
units.italian: "Bene. Il succo è più o meno questo: l'Incursione non è venuta dal nulla. Tutti dicono che sono arrivati da oltre i limiti estremi dell'esplorazione Avgi, ma non è del tutto vero. I primi a incontrarli sono stati una nave esploratrice, abbattuta in pochi minuti dalle loro armi. Ma non prima di aver inviato una sola trasmissione confusa alla nave gemella, che è fuggita indietro verso il resto degli Avgi."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	He pauses, taking a drink of what looks like water. "They said they had found a gateway of sorts, an ancient alien artifact built by an unknown Antecessor species. Somehow, they had activated it, and that's where the first Aberrant came from."|961|0
units.english: He pauses, taking a drink of what looks like water. "They said they had found a gateway of sorts, an ancient alien artifact built by an unknown Antecessor species. Somehow, they had activated it, and that's where the first Aberrant came from."
units.italian: Fa una pausa e beve quello che sembra acqua. "Dicevano di aver trovato una specie di varco, un antico manufatto alieno costruito da una specie Antecessors sconosciuta. In qualche modo l'avevano attivato, ed è da lì che sono arrivati i primi Aberranti."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	"And you want to use this gateway as a way out?"|963|0
units.english: "And you want to use this gateway as a way out?"
units.italian: "E vorresti usare questo varco come via d'uscita?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	"Where do you think this gateway leads?"|964|0
units.english: "Where do you think this gateway leads?"
units.italian: "Dove pensi che porti questo varco?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	"I don't know where it leads, but it'll be somewhere other than Avgi space. Maybe somewhere your jump drive can work, which would let us eventually make our way back to human space. But it's better than sitting here and twiddling our thumbs for another six years."|966|0
units.english: "I don't know where it leads, but it'll be somewhere other than Avgi space. Maybe somewhere your jump drive can work, which would let us eventually make our way back to human space. But it's better than sitting here and twiddling our thumbs for another six years."
units.italian: "Non so dove porti, ma sarà un posto diverso dallo spazio Avgi. Magari un posto dove il tuo motore di salto funziona, e allora potremmo alla fine tornare nello spazio umano. In ogni caso è meglio che stare qui a girarci i pollici per altri sei anni."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	"Where is this gateway?" Darius asks.|967|0
units.english: "Where is this gateway?" Darius asks.
units.italian: "Dov'è questo varco?" chiede Darius.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	"The Aberrant came from the East, beyond the furthest reaches of the Twilight. A place the Avgi always had trouble exploring, due to strange energy storms periodically ionizing entire systems. But it's apparently recognizable by the red nebula suffusing it, just as the Twilight is surrounded by a cluster of blue nebulae."|968|0
units.english: "The Aberrant came from the East, beyond the furthest reaches of the Twilight. A place the Avgi always had trouble exploring, due to strange energy storms periodically ionizing entire systems. But it's apparently recognizable by the red nebula suffusing it, just as the Twilight is surrounded by a cluster of blue nebulae."
units.italian: "Gli Aberranti sono arrivati da est, oltre i limiti estremi del Twilight. Un luogo che gli Avgi hanno sempre fatto fatica a esplorare, per via di strane tempeste energetiche che periodicamente ionizzano interi sistemi. Ma a quanto pare si riconosce da una nebulosa rossa che lo pervade, così come il Twilight è circondato da un ammasso di nebulose blu."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	"I've heard of that area. It's called the Ember Waste."|972|0
units.english: "I've heard of that area. It's called the Ember Waste."
units.italian: "Ho sentito parlare di quella zona. Si chiama Ember Waste."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	"Can it take us back to human space?" asks Leon, to which you nod.|973|0
units.english: "Can it take us back to human space?" asks Leon, to which you nod.
units.italian: "Può riportarci nello spazio umano?" chiede Leon, e tu annuisci.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|label|975|0
units.english: unknown ember waste
units.italian: unknown ember waste

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	"There's no point in waiting, then. If there's a chance, even a small one, it's worth checking on," says Darius, looking hopeful for the first time since you've met him.|976|0
units.english: "There's no point in waiting, then. If there's a chance, even a small one, it's worth checking on," says Darius, looking hopeful for the first time since you've met him.
units.italian: "Allora non ha senso aspettare. Se c'è una possibilità, anche piccola, vale la pena verificarla", dice Darius, speranzoso per la prima volta da quando lo conosci.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	You just hope his hope isn't a false one, for both of your sakes.|979|0
units.english: You just hope his hope isn't a false one, for both of your sakes.
units.italian: Speri solo che la sua speranza non sia falsa, per il bene di entrambi.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|As the purple flames of your jump drive fade, Darius, Sora, and Leon are all speechless. For the first time in six years, they are back in human space.|985|0
units.english: As the purple flames of your jump drive fade, Darius, Sora, and Leon are all speechless. For the first time in six years, they are back in human space.
units.italian: Mentre le fiamme viola del motore di salto svaniscono, Darius, Sora e Leon restano senza parole. Per la prima volta in sei anni sono tornati nello spazio umano.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	"Heh, told you we'd make it."|987|0
units.english: "Heh, told you we'd make it."
units.italian: "Eh, te l'avevo detto che ce l'avremmo fatta."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	"We're out. Where to now?"|988|0
units.english: "We're out. Where to now?"
units.italian: "Siamo fuori. E ora dove andiamo?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	Leon stares for a moment, then swears. "That damn magnetar was there the entire time? I was there for years. Years!"|990|0
units.english: Leon stares for a moment, then swears. "That damn magnetar was there the entire time? I was there for years. Years!"
units.italian: Leon fissa il vuoto per un momento, poi impreca. "Quel dannato magnetar era lì tutto il tempo? Sono stato lì per anni. Anni!"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	"We all were. And you wouldn't have been able to do anything with it without <first>'s jump drive," reminds Sora.|991|0
units.english: "We all were. And you wouldn't have been able to do anything with it without <first>'s jump drive," reminds Sora.
units.italian: "Ci siamo stati tutti. E non avresti potuto farci nulla senza il motore di salto di <first>", gli ricorda Sora.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	"<first>," says Darius in a shaky voice. "Take us to the Deep, please. I need to see my home. And my wife."|992|0
units.english: "<first>," says Darius in a shaky voice. "Take us to the Deep, please. I need to see my home. And my wife."
units.italian: "<first>", dice Darius con la voce tremante. "Portaci alla Deep, per favore. Devo vedere casa mia. E mia moglie."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	"Drop me off on Vinci first," interjects Leon. "I need to get my life in order again, and there's someone there I need to talk to about all this. It's on the way to the Deep, anyway."|993|0
units.english: "Drop me off on Vinci first," interjects Leon. "I need to get my life in order again, and there's someone there I need to talk to about all this. It's on the way to the Deep, anyway."
units.italian: "Prima lasciami su Vinci", interviene Leon. "Devo rimettere in ordine la mia vita, e lì c'è qualcuno con cui devo parlare di tutta questa storia. Tanto è sulla strada per la Deep."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|log|995|0
units.english: Successfully escaped the Twilight together with the humans stranded there.
units.italian: Sono riuscito a fuggire dal Twilight insieme agli umani che vi erano bloccati.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|log|996|0
units.english: Leon is extremely grateful for helping him return to human space. He wants to tell a contact on Vinci about the Avgi, and asks to stay in touch.
units.italian: Leon è estremamente grato per averlo aiutato a tornare nello spazio umano. Vuole parlare degli Avgi con un contatto su Vinci e chiede di restare in contatto.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|The group is quiet as you set the <ship> down on the landing pad. You notice Sora watching out a window as Darius looks into his hands. As for Leon, he has been ready to leave even before you've hit the atmosphere, pacing near the hatch until the moment you open it.|1000|0
units.english: The group is quiet as you set the <ship> down on the landing pad. You notice Sora watching out a window as Darius looks into his hands. As for Leon, he has been ready to leave even before you've hit the atmosphere, pacing near the hatch until the moment you open it.
units.italian: Il gruppo è silenzioso mentre posi la <ship> sulla piazzola. Noti Sora che guarda fuori dalla finestra mentre Darius si fissa le mani. Quanto a Leon, era pronto a scendere già prima che entraste in atmosfera, e cammina avanti e indietro vicino al portello finché non lo apri.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	"I'm going to get some fresh air," says Sora, stepping in front of an outraged Leon out of nowhere, a reluctant Darius dragged along with her. "We'll be in the spaceport, so try not to leave without us."|1001|0
units.english: "I'm going to get some fresh air," says Sora, stepping in front of an outraged Leon out of nowhere, a reluctant Darius dragged along with her. "We'll be in the spaceport, so try not to leave without us."
units.italian: "Vado a prendere una boccata d'aria", dice Sora, comparendo all'improvviso davanti a un Leon indignato e trascinandosi dietro un Darius riluttante. "Saremo allo spazioporto, quindi cerca di non partire senza di noi."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	Leon, consigned to being the last one out, stops just before he leaves the <ship>, turning to you. "<first>. Thank you." He is uncharacteristically somber, his usual sense of disdain for the world missing, for the moment.|1002|0
units.english: Leon, consigned to being the last one out, stops just before he leaves the <ship>, turning to you. "<first>. Thank you." He is uncharacteristically somber, his usual sense of disdain for the world missing, for the moment.
units.italian: Leon, rassegnato a uscire per ultimo, si ferma appena prima di lasciare la <ship> e si volta verso di te. "<first>. Grazie." È insolitamente serio: per un momento la sua solita aria di disprezzo per il mondo non c'è.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	"Don't worry about it."|1004|0
units.english: "Don't worry about it."
units.italian: "Non c'è di che."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	"I'm glad I was able to help."|1005|0
units.english: "I'm glad I was able to help."
units.italian: "Sono contento di aver potuto aiutare."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	"No, really. I was expecting to die back there, with those Avgi. Six years... I don't know how to thank you, but if you're ever in the area and you need anything don't hesitate to give me a call." With that, he shakes your hand and sets off in the direction Sora and Darius went, toward Vinci's spaceport.|1007|0
units.english: "No, really. I was expecting to die back there, with those Avgi. Six years... I don't know how to thank you, but if you're ever in the area and you need anything don't hesitate to give me a call." With that, he shakes your hand and sets off in the direction Sora and Darius went, toward Vinci's spaceport.
units.italian: "No, davvero. Mi aspettavo di morire laggiù, con quegli Avgi. Sei anni... non so come ringraziarti, ma se mai ti trovi in zona e hai bisogno di qualcosa, non esitare a chiamarmi." Detto questo ti stringe la mano e si avvia nella direzione presa da Sora e Darius, verso lo spazioporto di Vinci.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|	Remember to meet Darius and Sora in the spaceport before you leave Vinci.|1008|0
units.english: Remember to meet Darius and Sora in the spaceport before you leave Vinci.
units.italian: Ricordati di incontrare Darius e Sora allo spazioporto prima di lasciare Vinci.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 1|dialog|1010|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Darius, Sora, and Leon hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la scorta con Darius, Sora e Leon non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 2|name|1014|0
units.english: Sora's Return
units.italian: Il ritorno di Sora

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 2|description|1015|0
units.english: Take Sora to her parents' farm on Memory.
units.italian: Porta Sora alla fattoria dei suoi genitori su Memory.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 2|blocked|1019|0
units.english: You'll need <capacity> on the <ship> to transport Darious and Sora.
units.italian: Ti serve <capacity> sulla <ship> per trasportare Darius e Sora.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 2|You find Darius and Sora sitting outside a cafe, sipping coffee. "Been a long time since we've had a good cup," explains Sora, pulling a chair out for you.|1024|0
units.english: You find Darius and Sora sitting outside a cafe, sipping coffee. "Been a long time since we've had a good cup," explains Sora, pulling a chair out for you.
units.italian: Trovi Darius e Sora seduti fuori da un caffè, che sorseggiano. "È da tanto che non ne beviamo uno buono", spiega Sora, tirandoti fuori una sedia.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 2|	"What, no coffee in Avgi space?" you joke.|1025|0
units.english: "What, no coffee in Avgi space?" you joke.
units.italian: "Come, niente caffè nello spazio Avgi?" scherzi.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 2|	"Nah, but you should try their drinks sometime. Man, they're something else."|1026|0
units.english: "Nah, but you should try their drinks sometime. Man, they're something else."
units.italian: "Macché, ma dovresti provare le loro bevande. Ragazzo, sono tutta un'altra cosa."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 2|	"There's nothing like being back, though," Darius says, quiet as he takes in the bustling spaceport around you. "It's hard to believe I'm really here. Harder to understand why it was I that made it out of there when so many who followed me didn't."|1027|0
units.english: "There's nothing like being back, though," Darius says, quiet as he takes in the bustling spaceport around you. "It's hard to believe I'm really here. Harder to understand why it was I that made it out of there when so many who followed me didn't."
units.italian: "Però non c'è niente come essere tornati", dice Darius, sommesso, mentre osserva lo spazioporto brulicante intorno a voi. "È difficile credere di essere davvero qui. Ancora più difficile capire perché sia uscito io, da laggiù, quando tanti che mi hanno seguito no."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 2|	"Oh, stop that." Sora swats the back of his head. "You're not the first to make a wrong turn into a bad neighborhood. Remember that story about your wife?" Her tone is playful, but you can see the look of worry in her eyes at the evident guilt Darius feels.|1028|0
units.english: "Oh, stop that." Sora swats the back of his head. "You're not the first to make a wrong turn into a bad neighborhood. Remember that story about your wife?" Her tone is playful, but you can see the look of worry in her eyes at the evident guilt Darius feels.
units.italian: "Oh, smettila." Sora gli dà un colpetto sulla nuca. "Non sei il primo che sbaglia strada e finisce in un quartiere brutto. Ti ricordi quella storia su tua moglie?" Il tono è scherzoso, ma negli occhi le si legge la preoccupazione per il senso di colpa evidente di Darius.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 2|	Darius shakes his head, then continues. "We should get you home. Your parents probably still have that farm, it's been in the family for years. It's not too far from here, right?"|1029|0
units.english: Darius shakes his head, then continues. "We should get you home. Your parents probably still have that farm, it's been in the family for years. It's not too far from here, right?"
units.italian: Darius scuote la testa, poi continua. "Dovremmo portarti a casa. I tuoi genitori avranno ancora quella fattoria, è della famiglia da anni. Non è troppo lontana da qui, vero?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 2|	A pause, and then Sora says, "Memory. I haven't been there in years, but I guess my apartment is definitely gone... so I have nowhere else to go for now."|1030|0
units.english: A pause, and then Sora says, "Memory. I haven't been there in years, but I guess my apartment is definitely gone... so I have nowhere else to go for now."
units.italian: Una pausa, poi Sora dice: "Memory. Non ci torno da anni, ma suppongo che il mio appartamento non ci sia più... quindi per ora non ho altro posto dove andare."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 2|	"Let's get to it then. <first>, could you take us to Memory?"|1031|0
units.english: "Let's get to it then. <first>, could you take us to Memory?"
units.italian: "Allora andiamo. <first>, puoi portarci su Memory?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 2|	"Of course," you say.|1032|0
units.english: "Of course," you say.
units.italian: "Certo", dici.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 2|log|1036|0
units.english: Agreed to take Sora to her parents' farm on Memory, as she has nowhere else to go.
units.italian: Ho accettato di portare Sora alla fattoria dei suoi genitori su Memory, visto che non ha altro posto dove andare.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 2|log|1037|0
units.english: Despite escaping the Twilight, Darius still feels guilty over his crew members that lost their lives to the Aberrant.
units.italian: Nonostante la fuga dal Twilight, Darius si sente ancora in colpa per i membri del suo equipaggio che hanno perso la vita contro gli Aberranti.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 2|dialog|1039|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Darius and Sora hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la scorta con Darius e Sora non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|name|1044|0
units.english: Darius' Return
units.italian: Il ritorno di Darius

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|description|1045|0
units.english: Take Darius to his home on Valhalla, in the hope his wife is still there since his apparent death.
units.italian: Porta Darius a casa sua su Valhalla, sperando che sua moglie sia ancora lì dopo la sua presunta morte.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|blocked|1049|0
units.english: You'll need <capacity> on the <ship> to transport Darius.
units.italian: Ti serve <capacity> sulla <ship> per trasportare Darius.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|log|1053|0
units.english: Darius is extremely devoted to his wife Katrina, but worries that she may have moved on in the six years he's been missing.
units.italian: Darius è estremamente devoto a sua moglie Katrina, ma teme che lei possa aver voltato pagina nei sei anni della sua assenza.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|Memory is a dry world, covered in sands and shrubland. From the spaceport, the three of you catch a shuttle bus that heads out into the countryside, passing miles of cacti and dry plants that abruptly turn into greener fields of crops, probably irrigated by aquifers. It is one of these farms you finally arrive at, the one Sora says belongs to her parents. Traffic must be rare here, because only a few minutes after the bus stops the door to the well-maintained farmhouse opens, a middle-aged couple peering out.|1055|0
units.english: Memory is a dry world, covered in sands and shrubland. From the spaceport, the three of you catch a shuttle bus that heads out into the countryside, passing miles of cacti and dry plants that abruptly turn into greener fields of crops, probably irrigated by aquifers. It is one of these farms you finally arrive at, the one Sora says belongs to her parents. Traffic must be rare here, because only a few minutes after the bus stops the door to the well-maintained farmhouse opens, a middle-aged couple peering out.
units.italian: Memory è un mondo arido, coperto di sabbia e arbusti. Dallo spazioporto prendete un bus navetta che si dirige verso la campagna, attraversando chilometri di cactus e piante secche che a un tratto lasciano il posto a campi coltivati più verdi, probabilmente irrigati da falde acquifere. È a una di queste fattorie che arrivate, quella che Sora dice essere dei suoi genitori. Il traffico qui deve essere raro, perché bastano pochi minuti dalla fermata del bus perché si apra la porta della casa colonica ben tenuta, con una coppia di mezza età che si affaccia.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|	"...Sora? Is that you?" the older woman calls out while the man gapes in silence.|1056|0
units.english: "...Sora? Is that you?" the older woman calls out while the man gapes in silence.
units.italian: "...Sora? Sei tu?" chiama la donna più anziana, mentre l'uomo resta a bocca aperta in silenzio.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|	Eyes shining, Sora gives you and Darius a crushing hug before she leaves you. "Thank you, <first>. And Darius," she gives him a stern look, "I'll be in touch. Don't be so hard on yourself." He nods mutely as she turns and runs towards the house.|1057|0
units.english: Eyes shining, Sora gives you and Darius a crushing hug before she leaves you. "Thank you, <first>. And Darius," she gives him a stern look, "I'll be in touch. Don't be so hard on yourself." He nods mutely as she turns and runs towards the house.
units.italian: Con gli occhi lucidi, Sora vi stringe in un abbraccio forte, te e Darius, prima di lasciarvi. "Grazie, <first>. E Darius", gli lancia uno sguardo severo, "ti farò sapere. Non essere così duro con te stesso." Lui annuisce senza parole mentre lei si volta e corre verso la casa.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|	You don't want to interrupt the reunion, so you and Darius take your leave together, returning to the spaceport. Back aboard the <ship>, you sit in a comfortable silence for a while.|1058|0
units.english: You don't want to interrupt the reunion, so you and Darius take your leave together, returning to the spaceport. Back aboard the <ship>, you sit in a comfortable silence for a while.
units.italian: Non vuoi interrompere la riunione, così tu e Darius ve ne andate insieme, tornando allo spazioporto. Di nuovo a bordo della <ship>, restate seduti in un silenzio tranquillo per un po'.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|	"So, where do you want me to take you?"|1060|0
units.english: "So, where do you want me to take you?"
units.italian: "Allora, dove vuoi che ti porti?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|	"So, where next?"|1061|0
units.english: "So, where next?"
units.italian: "E ora dove andiamo?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|	"...I don't know. My wife, Katrina... we lived on Valhalla, but it's been six years. She probably thought I was dead, hell, the whole Republic probably thought I was dead. She..." he chokes up, "she's probably moved on by now. I would have wanted her to, she knew that."|1062|0
units.english: "...I don't know. My wife, Katrina... we lived on Valhalla, but it's been six years. She probably thought I was dead, hell, the whole Republic probably thought I was dead. She..." he chokes up, "she's probably moved on by now. I would have wanted her to, she knew that."
units.italian: "...Non lo so. Mia moglie, Katrina... vivevamo su Valhalla, ma sono passati sei anni. Probabilmente mi ha creduto morto, diavolo, tutta la Repubblica probabilmente mi ha creduto morto. Lei..." la voce gli si spezza, "probabilmente ormai è andata avanti. Io avrei voluto che lo facesse, lei lo sapeva."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|	"You have to find out, one way or another. Let's go to Valhalla."|1064|0
units.english: "You have to find out, one way or another. Let's go to Valhalla."
units.italian: "Devi scoprirlo, in un modo o nell'altro. Andiamo su Valhalla."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|	"I'm sure she's been waiting for you. Let's go to Valhalla."|1065|0
units.english: "I'm sure she's been waiting for you. Let's go to Valhalla."
units.italian: "Sono sicuro che ti ha aspettato. Andiamo su Valhalla."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|	"I don't know if I can face the truth. But I also can't just go my own way without even checking on her, just in case there's a chance she didn't give up in me."|1067|0
units.english: "I don't know if I can face the truth. But I also can't just go my own way without even checking on her, just in case there's a chance she didn't give up in me."
units.italian: "Non so se riesco ad affrontare la verità. Ma non posso nemmeno andare per la mia strada senza nemmeno controllare, nel caso ci sia una possibilità che non abbia smesso di credere in me."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|	Darius rubs his eyes. "Thank you, <first>. I hope I'm wrong. Let's go to Valhalla."|1069|0
units.english: Darius rubs his eyes. "Thank you, <first>. I hope I'm wrong. Let's go to Valhalla."
units.italian: Darius si strofina gli occhi. "Grazie, <first>. Spero di sbagliarmi. Andiamo su Valhalla."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|log|1073|0
units.english: After reuniting Sora with her parents, agreed to help Darius find his wife on Valhalla.
units.italian: Dopo aver riportato Sora dai suoi genitori, ho accettato di aiutare Darius a trovare sua moglie su Valhalla.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|log|1076|0
units.english: Successfully reunited Darius with his wife Katrina, who refused to believe he was dead.
units.italian: Sono riuscito a riunire Darius a sua moglie Katrina, che si è sempre rifiutata di crederlo morto.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|log|1077|0
units.english: Katrina is Darius' wife, who moved out of the city but refused to believe he was dead.
units.italian: Katrina è la moglie di Darius: si è trasferita fuori città ma si è rifiutata di credere che fosse morto.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|You land in Valhalla's main spaceport, and Darius practically jumps out of your ship before it can even touch down. A quick call for an automated taxi, and you soon find yourselves outside an expansive, fancy-looking apartment complex. "Our old address," he explains. "We were still renting, but were looking at buying our apartment within a few years."|1079|0
units.english: You land in Valhalla's main spaceport, and Darius practically jumps out of your ship before it can even touch down. A quick call for an automated taxi, and you soon find yourselves outside an expansive, fancy-looking apartment complex. "Our old address," he explains. "We were still renting, but were looking at buying our apartment within a few years."
units.italian: Atterri nello spazioporto principale di Valhalla, e Darius praticamente salta fuori dalla nave prima ancora che tocchi terra. Una rapida chiamata a un taxi automatico e vi ritrovate davanti a un vasto complesso residenziale dall'aria elegante. "Il nostro vecchio indirizzo", spiega. "Eravamo ancora in affitto, ma pensavamo di comprare l'appartamento entro qualche anno."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|	You knock on the door to the right apartment, but it is answered by a tall man with black hair. "Hello, can I help you?" he asks cautiously.|1080|0
units.english: You knock on the door to the right apartment, but it is answered by a tall man with black hair. "Hello, can I help you?" he asks cautiously.
units.italian: Bussi alla porta dell'appartamento giusto, ma ad aprire è un uomo alto dai capelli neri. "Salve, posso aiutarla?" chiede con cautela.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|	Darius looks crushed. "Is... Is there a Katrina here?"|1081|0
units.english: Darius looks crushed. "Is... Is there a Katrina here?"
units.italian: Darius sembra distrutto. "C'è... c'è una Katrina, qui?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|	"Katrina? Can't say I've met anyone with that name in the five years I've lived here. Is that a friend of yours?"|1082|0
units.english: "Katrina? Can't say I've met anyone with that name in the five years I've lived here. Is that a friend of yours?"
units.italian: "Katrina? Non posso dire di aver conosciuto qualcuno con quel nome nei cinque anni che vivo qui. È un'amica sua?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|	Darius looks morose as he turns away. "Yes. I'm sorry for troubling you, we'll be on our way."|1083|0
units.english: Darius looks morose as he turns away. "Yes. I'm sorry for troubling you, we'll be on our way."
units.italian: Darius si volta con aria tetra. "Sì. Mi scusi il disturbo, ce ne andiamo."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|	"Don't give up. She probably just moved or something."|1085|0
units.english: "Don't give up. She probably just moved or something."
units.italian: "Non arrenderti. Probabilmente si è solo trasferita, o roba simile."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|	"We could try looking her information up."|1086|0
units.english: "We could try looking her information up."
units.italian: "Potremmo provare a cercare le sue informazioni."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|	"Of course she did. But I don't understand why, buying that apartment was our dream. It doesn't make any sense!" He stops himself. "Sorry, <first>. I'm just on edge." He sighs before continuing. "I can try looking her up, maybe..." he trails off, thinking.|1088|0
units.english: "Of course she did. But I don't understand why, buying that apartment was our dream. It doesn't make any sense!" He stops himself. "Sorry, <first>. I'm just on edge." He sighs before continuing. "I can try looking her up, maybe..." he trails off, thinking.
units.italian: "Certo che l'ha fatto. Ma non capisco perché, comprare quell'appartamento era il nostro sogno. Non ha alcun senso!" Si ferma. "Scusa, <first>. Sono solo nervoso." Sospira prima di continuare. "Posso provare a cercarla, forse..." si interrompe, pensieroso.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|	"Any public records on Valhalla?" you ask.|1089|0
units.english: "Any public records on Valhalla?" you ask.
units.italian: "Ci sono registri pubblici su Valhalla?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|	"...Yes, we'll try the record books. We can check them at the library."|1091|0
units.english: "...Yes, we'll try the record books. We can check them at the library."
units.italian: "...Sì, proveremo con i registri. Possiamo consultarli in biblioteca."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|	A short trip to the library later, and you sit at a table while Darius checks the public records. He scrolls down the list of names and addresses before stopping at a single name. "Katrina... Caldwell. Our name." Hope is plainly visible on his face. "She kept our name, at least."|1092|0
units.english: A short trip to the library later, and you sit at a table while Darius checks the public records. He scrolls down the list of names and addresses before stopping at a single name. "Katrina... Caldwell. Our name." Hope is plainly visible on his face. "She kept our name, at least."
units.italian: Dopo un breve tragitto fino alla biblioteca, ti siedi a un tavolo mentre Darius consulta i registri pubblici. Scorre l'elenco di nomi e indirizzi e si ferma su un nome. "Katrina... Caldwell. Il nostro cognome." La speranza gli si legge in faccia. "Almeno ha tenuto il nostro cognome."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|	You glance over at the address, taking note of it. It looks like it's further out of the city. "Let's try the address. We can still make it there by tonight," you say.|1093|0
units.english: You glance over at the address, taking note of it. It looks like it's further out of the city. "Let's try the address. We can still make it there by tonight," you say.
units.italian: Dai un'occhiata all'indirizzo e lo annoti. Sembra essere più fuori città. "Proviamo quell'indirizzo. Possiamo arrivarci entro stasera", dici.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|	The address appears to be out in the country, and you take in the view as the taxi smoothly glides along the roads. Unlike on Memory, the landscape here is lush and green, with rolling hills, abundant forests, and rushing streams. You find that the address belongs to a cozy-looking riverfront house, a large garden visible next to it.|1094|0
units.english: The address appears to be out in the country, and you take in the view as the taxi smoothly glides along the roads. Unlike on Memory, the landscape here is lush and green, with rolling hills, abundant forests, and rushing streams. You find that the address belongs to a cozy-looking riverfront house, a large garden visible next to it.
units.italian: L'indirizzo risulta essere in campagna, e ammiri il paesaggio mentre il taxi scivola liscio lungo le strade. A differenza di Memory, qui il paesaggio è verde e rigoglioso, con colline dolci, foreste fitte e torrenti impetuosi. Scopri che l'indirizzo corrisponde a una casa accogliente sul fiume, con un grande giardino visibile accanto.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|	Darius has never looked so nervous in his life, but you give him a gentle shove towards the door. His knocking is unanswered, and his face starts to once more slip into despair, but you hear a voice from the garden.|1095|0
units.english: Darius has never looked so nervous in his life, but you give him a gentle shove towards the door. His knocking is unanswered, and his face starts to once more slip into despair, but you hear a voice from the garden.
units.italian: Darius non è mai stato così nervoso in vita sua, ma gli dai una spinta gentile verso la porta. Alla sua bussata non risponde nessuno, e il suo viso ricomincia a scivolare nella disperazione, ma senti una voce dal giardino.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|	"Darius? Is that you?" A woman with greying hair steps onto the porch, eyes shining. "You're back... I knew you were alive!" she cries out, rushing to embrace him. The two begin speaking, faster than you can follow, as you hang back somewhat awkwardly.|1096|0
units.english: "Darius? Is that you?" A woman with greying hair steps onto the porch, eyes shining. "You're back... I knew you were alive!" she cries out, rushing to embrace him. The two begin speaking, faster than you can follow, as you hang back somewhat awkwardly.
units.italian: "Darius? Sei tu?" Una donna dai capelli grigi esce sul portico, con gli occhi lucidi. "Sei tornato... sapevo che eri vivo!" esclama, correndo ad abbracciarlo. I due cominciano a parlare a una velocità che non riesci a seguire, mentre tu resti indietro un po' impacciato.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|	After a few minutes, you try to excuse yourself, but Darius won't have it. "No, no, I owe this all to you, <first>. You're the only reason I'm here."|1097|0
units.english: After a few minutes, you try to excuse yourself, but Darius won't have it. "No, no, I owe this all to you, <first>. You're the only reason I'm here."
units.italian: Dopo qualche minuto provi a congedarti, ma Darius non vuole. "No, no, devo tutto a te, <first>. Sei l'unico motivo per cui sono qui."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|	Katrina looks at you curiously. "Aliens, huh? You don't look like an alien."|1098|0
units.english: Katrina looks at you curiously. "Aliens, huh? You don't look like an alien."
units.italian: Katrina ti guarda incuriosita. "Alieni, eh? Non hai l'aria di un alieno."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|	"Huh?"|1100|0
units.english: "Huh?"
units.italian: "Come?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|	"That's because I'm not."|1101|0
units.english: "That's because I'm not."
units.italian: "È perché non lo sono."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|	"Yeah, these skinsuits are pretty good."|1102|0
units.english: "Yeah, these skinsuits are pretty good."
units.italian: "Sì, queste tute di pelle sono fatte proprio bene."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|	She bursts out laughing. "I wouldn't believe it if anyone else had told me. I mean, men come up with all sorts of excuses for coming home late, but this is something else!" Her tone suddenly turns serious. "It'll be a headache, working all this out with the government. They gave me the money for this place as recompense for your supposed 'death,' no matter how much I insisted you were still alive."|1103|0
units.english: She bursts out laughing. "I wouldn't believe it if anyone else had told me. I mean, men come up with all sorts of excuses for coming home late, but this is something else!" Her tone suddenly turns serious. "It'll be a headache, working all this out with the government. They gave me the money for this place as recompense for your supposed 'death,' no matter how much I insisted you were still alive."
units.italian: Scoppia a ridere. "Non ci crederei se me lo avesse detto chiunque altro. Insomma, gli uomini inventano ogni scusa per tornare a casa tardi, ma questa è un'altra cosa!" Il tono diventa all'improvviso serio. "Sarà un grattacapo sistemare tutto con il governo. Mi hanno dato i soldi per questa casa come risarcimento per la tua presunta 'morte', per quanto io abbia insistito che eri ancora vivo."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|	"We'll work it out. They owe me backpay anyway," jokes Darius, still in Katrina's arms.|1104|0
units.english: "We'll work it out. They owe me backpay anyway," jokes Darius, still in Katrina's arms.
units.italian: "Lo sistemeremo. Tanto mi devono gli arretrati", scherza Darius, ancora tra le braccia di Katrina.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|	As the pair move to the door, you say your goodbyes, and Darius promises he will keep in touch with you about the Avgi. Neither of you have forgotten the aliens fighting to survive at the edge of the galaxy, and now that you know of a safe way in and out of their space, you can go back without fear of becoming trapped.|1105|0
units.english: As the pair move to the door, you say your goodbyes, and Darius promises he will keep in touch with you about the Avgi. Neither of you have forgotten the aliens fighting to survive at the edge of the galaxy, and now that you know of a safe way in and out of their space, you can go back without fear of becoming trapped.
units.italian: Mentre i due si avviano alla porta, vi salutate, e Darius promette che ti terrà aggiornato sugli Avgi. Nessuno dei due ha dimenticato gli alieni che lottano per sopravvivere ai margini della galassia, e ora che conosci una via sicura per entrare e uscire dal loro spazio, puoi tornarci senza il timore di restare intrappolato.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Twilight Escape 3|dialog|1107|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Darius hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la scorta con Darius non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Discovery of Decet Magnetar|log|1117|0
units.english: Discovered a magnetar in the Decet system that can boost the range of my jump drive in an apparent inversion of the mysterious effect that trapped me here.
units.italian: Ho scoperto un magnetar nel sistema Decet che può aumentare la portata del mio motore di salto, in quella che sembra l'inversione dell'effetto misterioso che mi aveva intrappolato qui.

units.id: mission:Discovery of Decet Magnetar|Just as your jump drive reacted strangely when you first entered Avgi space, it does so again, but this time the effect is inverted. The plasma from your jump lingers unnaturally, as though energized by something outside. Your instrumentation tells you your jump drive is much warmer than it should be just after a jump, almost hot enough to be dangerous. Perhaps your jump drive's range has changed as well?|1120|0
units.english: Just as your jump drive reacted strangely when you first entered Avgi space, it does so again, but this time the effect is inverted. The plasma from your jump lingers unnaturally, as though energized by something outside. Your instrumentation tells you your jump drive is much warmer than it should be just after a jump, almost hot enough to be dangerous. Perhaps your jump drive's range has changed as well?
units.italian: Proprio come il motore di salto aveva reagito in modo strano al primo ingresso nello spazio Avgi, succede di nuovo, ma questa volta l'effetto è invertito. Il plasma del salto indugia in modo innaturale, come se fosse stato caricato da qualcosa di esterno. Gli strumenti indicano che il motore di salto è molto più caldo di quanto dovrebbe essere subito dopo un salto, quasi da diventare pericoloso. Forse anche la portata del motore di salto è cambiata?
